description: This file defines the interface `AcknowledgementLabel` which represents labels used for acknowledgements (ACKs) in the system. It provides static factory methods, comparison logic, and methods to inspect label states, serving as a core abstraction within the acknowledgment handling component.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AcknowledgementLabel from a character sequence, validating the input.

methods.name: isFullyResolved
methods.description: Default method to check if the label has no unresolved placeholders.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Comparison implementation based on the string representation of the label.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string value of the label.
